title: , Bishop of Nicomedia
, Fellow-Ascetic of the Great Euthymius
name: Anthimus
Theoctistus
troparia: (Tone 4) Having shared the way of life of the apostles,* and having become a successor to their thrones,* labouring you found the divinely inspired way to contemplation.* Therefore, forthrightly ministering the word of truth,* you shed your blood for the faith, O hieromartyr, Anthimus.* Intercede with Christ our God for the salvation of our souls.

(Tone 8) Your abundant tears made the wilderness bloom,* and your sufferings made your labours fruitful a hundredfold;* you became a shining torch over the world.* O venerable father Theoctistus,* pray to Christ our God that He may save our souls.
